source_en: Phew... I suppose the young man's got a point.⏎Getting defeated by the same opponent twice in a row doesn't make for ⏎the most compelling story. Audiences love it when you change it up...

source_en: Eltnam Senior
source_slot: EltnamSenior

source_en: Still, changing it up too much is no good, either. What if the story⏎ends with me, an outsider popping in out of nowhere, defeating the⏎root of all evil? That's just asking for backlash.
source_slot: Comunque, neanche cambiare troppo va bene. Tipo, se la storia⏎finisse con me, una outsider sbucata fuori dal nulla, che estirpa⏎il male alla radice, sai poi quando protestano i fan?

source_en: ...Let them hate, then. I actually like that idea.⏎So you're the one bound by laws beyond this world's?⏎You're every bit as intriguing as I'd imagined.

source_en: Eltnam Senior
source_slot: EltnamSenior

source_en: And you must be the rookie of all rookies. Just who I'm here to see--⏎and give a good talking-to. Thanks for taking ten whole years to show⏎up. I knew you'd be hiding here, so I had my last opponent forfeit.

source_en: Eltnam Senior
source_slot: EltnamSenior

source_en: Now, ideally, your silhouette would've slid into the frame, beaten down⏎that young man, and challenged me instead, as a twist. That would have⏎been a more elegant approach. Much, much better optics.
source_slot: Idealmente, saresti dovuto entrare tutto pesto nell'inquadratura⏎per sfidarmi, come colpo di scena.⏎Quello sì che sarebbe stato un ingresso ad effetto.

source_en: You don't say...? I'm sorry I couldn't live up to your expectations.⏎I should have done more research. Forgive me, I've really just awakened.⏎Next time, I'll be more prepared.

source_en: Eltnam Senior
source_slot: EltnamSenior

source_en: Next time? There won't be a next time. For either of us.⏎Now, let's hurry and begin while the kid's still asleep.

source_en: That, I can agree with.⏎I can only be so patient--⏎especially with such enticing prey in front of me...
